result.title: Equivalence testing and run-count design for stochastic machine-learning experiments
result.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code, simulation scripts and case-study data: https://github.com/DmytroKnopov/equivtest (release v0.2.0, archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23421510)
result.summary: Claims that two training methods perform equally well often rest on a non-significant difference between two or three runs per method. We develop a protocol, with its power theory, for certifying practical equivalence in per-run metrics such as the AUROC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve). It rests on a two-level (seed x item) variance model separating between-run dispersion from item-level noise. Equivalence within a pre-specified margin is tested by two one-sided tests (TOST), equivalently by a confidence interval inside the margin; a two-level bootstrap covers composite statistics. A closed-form formula converts a margin and a target power into runs per method; its shifted-t refinement is calibrated against the realised two-level process. Simulations on a 270-cell grid and under non-Gaussian seed laws confirm the formula within its design-relevant range, from five runs per method. For four published runs of a joint energy-based model, the failure to certify equivalence was largely decided by design: with the variance calibrated to those runs, two per method certify with probability near three per cent, whereas certifying 0.01 AUROC at 80 per cent power needs twelve even under exact equality. A second case study on a thousand-seed CIFAR-10 zoo and the MultiBERTs checks the formula against real seed laws (within 0.05 in that range) and resolves comparisons that two or three runs leave undecided. In a two-stage design (pilot, then formula), our experiments suggest that an upper confidence bound on the pilot variance substantially reduces the undersizing seen with its point estimate.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出随机机器学习实验中的等价性检验协议与运行次数设计：用 seed×item 两级方差模型区分 run 间波动与样本噪声，以 TOST/置信区间检验实用等价，并给出由 margin 和目标 power 反推每方法所需运行数的闭式公式，经仿真与两个案例验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其两级方差分解与等价性检验可为 LVR/VLM 推理方法对比提供线索：如何用有限随机种子判断两种 latent 推理方案是否「实际等价」，并把判定成本与实际运行预算显式核算，可供核查。
